# Minimal-Dark-Coder

Minimal-Dark-Coder is a dark theme built around clean typography, high-contrast syntax highlighting and readable code blocks. Its recorded description frames it as a low-clutter, distraction-free interface for developers taking notes and managing projects.

![Minimal-Dark-Coder screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krishna-sen-programming-world/Minimal-Dark-Coder/HEAD/images/image.jpg)
